positions.where: Bayerisches Geoinstitut, University of Bayreuth, Germany
positions.note: Thesis: the oxygen content of mantle sulphides.

Two years away from science. I arrived without much of a plan and stayed because the city kept asking questions I could not yet answer. I worked small jobs, learned to live inside a culture that was not mine, and found that being a little lost somewhere beautiful is a perfectly good way to discover what you actually want — and where you belong. Looking back it was a hard time, and I would not change a day of it. Bayreuth followed.
